checks.item: Missed errors (ok and uncertain samples)
checks.evidence: 20 random first-pass 'ok' rows (seed 101): 0 clear errors (2 ambiguous: Strawberry leaf scorch strawberry_leaf_scorch_google_0133.jpg and Pepper healthy v9hX3.jpg). 16 random label_uncertain rows (seed 202): 2 look like clear errors under the rule that removed other slides/collages (Pepper_bell___Bacterial_spot 01.jpg 'slide with text and one photo'; Squash powdery mildew squash_powdery_mildew_google_0004.jpg 'titled graphic collage'), the rest are isolated stock leaves/fruit or genuinely unsure. Estimates: ok pool 0/20 (95% upper bound by rule of three ~15%, so this sample cannot bound the miss rate); uncertain pool 2/16 = 12.5% (Wilson roughly 3% to 36%) -> about 30 of 248 uncertain, which would add at most about 1.5 points to the 1.5% dev+test removal rate. The config pattern sent 70 slide-like uncertain rows to the second look, which kept ~28 uncertain; 41 label_uncertain rows have slide/collage/graphic notes. Together with the calibration (2 of 4 known-bad removed), the true bad rate of train is plausibly ~3-4%, not well over 5%.

notes: Read the numbers as development numbers: the rates are lower bounds. (1) The second look is not consistent about slides/collages: removed rows include 'text slide with small photo', yet ~41 label_uncertain rows have slide/collage/graphic notes and 2 of my 16 sampled uncertain rows (Pepper_bell___Bacterial_spot 01.jpg, squash_powdery_mildew_google_0004.jpg) match the removal rule. Roughly 1.5 points more of dev+test could plausibly be removable; it does not change the ranking (cleaning moved scores under 1 point). Whoever uses clean:1 should know it leaves a handful of slide-like images in. (2) The 5% train decision (7/400, Wilson [0.9%, 3.6%]) is under the line, and with the calibration miss rate (about 2 of 4 known-bad found) a corrected train rate is roughly 3-4%, so I do not flag it as well over 5%, but it cannot be shown to be under 5% either; the 0/20 'ok' sample has an upper bound of ~15%, so it gives little power. (3) field_clean.csv drops only the 7 sampled train removals; the other ~2,000 field_train rows were not reviewed, so E12/T8.1 using clean:1 or field_clean.csv get cleaned dev/test but only partly reviewed train. clean:1 only applies to field_* splits and raises otherwise, so no silent fallback. (4) Records show labels_reviewed false at top level and 'device' only inside config; check_run accepts this. (5) Reviewers saw field_test photos and labels (19 removals are test rows): this is disclosed, no score used it, and T8.1 must restate it. (6) Three or four wrong_plant removals are species guesses from small photos (pepper seedling vs tomato, simple ovate leaves, cucurbit-type leaf); they are plausible but are the weakest removals. (7) The main folder's datasets/review/thumbs still need regeneration after merge, as stated. Re-verification at c4eb707: earlier passes stand for unchanged parts (data, records, review). No new failures.
